name: Quick Steam
author: Rysen Winters
description: Your Steam library one key away, with what Steam is doing right now: downloads, updates, Workshop items and shader pre-caching with progress bars, ProtonDB ratings, the Proton version per game and free space per library.

barWidget.description: Steam library launcher with live download and shader progress.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Language of the panel, the tooltip and the notifications. auto follows the system.

schema.label: Show activity
schema.description: Downloads, updates and shader pre-caching in progress, at the top of the panel.

schema.label: Show the game list
schema.description: Installed and not installed games, with search. Activity or the game list always stays on.

schema.label: Show game details
schema.description: Cover, ProtonDB, Proton version and store description of the selected game. Needs the game list.

schema.label: Show progress in the bar
schema.description: Show the percentage and a progress line under the icon while Steam downloads or compiles shaders.

schema.label: Notify finished downloads
schema.description: Send a notification when a game installed from the panel starts downloading, a game finishes installing or updating, or one uninstalled from the panel is gone.

schema.label: Notify finished shaders
schema.description: Send a notification when Steam empties its shader queue after more than a minute of background processing.
